Hello, it is nice to meet you. How are you today?
Could I have a small coffee and a glass of water, please?
Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the station?
I would like to make an appointment for Thursday morning.
Thank you for your help. Shall we discuss the project tomorrow?
Would you like to go for a walk with us this weekend?
Andrew, let's meet to plan our party.
New Year's is just around the corner.
Around the corner? It's still weeks away!
I know. There's not much time to plan!
You know I like to plan at the last minute.
I know! That's why I made you a to-do list.
Oh! Andrew, can you help me with this box?
Just a second. I'm almost done.
I'm on the last page.
It's really heavy!
Hold your horses! What's in the box?
Horses!
Hi Anna! How has your day been?
Great! Very great! Very productive!
I finished three reports and have only one more to do!
Wow, you are on the ball! How did you do them so fast?
Coffee! Lots of coffee. Do you want some?
Uh, sure. But maybe not that much coffee.
So, are you all ready for our big work trip to Brazil?
I just bought a new travel shirt, travel sunglasses and this travel guidebook!
Andrew, I hate to break the news, but you're not traveling.
Budget cuts. There's not enough money for two.
But can I borrow that travel book?
I love the start of the new year!
It's a great time to start fresh.
Me too! This year, I'm going to start with a clean slate and give up bad habits.
Like eating donuts and drinking too much coffee?
No. No, other bad habits.
Hey, I saw you at my party last night, but you didn't stay very long.
I knew no one, and I didn't have the energy to break the ice with a bunch of new people.
Asking questions is a good icebreaker.
True, but even if I broke the ice, I didn't have the energy to listen.
Hey, did you watch the new episode of Catch a Criminal?
Yeah, but it was such a no-brainer!
The police found a gun and all the money in David's house!
Well, what if David has a twin brother who lives with him?
The police would know if David had a twin brother.
Well, what if they don't know?
Pedro is finally moving to Hollywood to follow his acting dream.
He's been talking about that for years.
His plans are just pie in the sky.
His YouTube channel has over four million subscribers!
Four million?
Sometimes Dee really bothers me.
Uh-oh. What happened?
So, I joked about her singing.
And she got angry at me!
Oh, so she can dish it out but she can't take it!
All this talk about food is making me hungry.
Yeah, I'm starving, too!
Do you wanna grab a bite?
Sounds good.
Andrew, why are you wearing that wig?
I know it looks funny, but I feel like I've been stuck in a rut.
I'm just trying to change things up and feel more creative and different!
Got it! Is it working?
I think it's just making my head hot.
I love Amelia Earhart.
Her life really struck a chord with me.
Really? But she was a pilot.
And you're afraid of flying.
No, her flying career didn't strike a chord.
She loved hot chocolate.
And so do I!
Anna, where have you been? I lost you in the crowd.
I was playing games! I'm really good at carnival games!
I see that! You really won a lot of stuffed animals. Are you sure you didn't cheat?
No!
I won them all fair and square!
And they're all mine. All mine!
I just ate a bag of potato chips,
a couple of candy bars
and two sodas.
Are you kidding? That's a lot of junk food.
Dan, how is your new roommate?
He's such a couch potato.
He comes home from work and watches weird shows all night.
Well, it could be worse.
Could it?
He watches Norwegian zombie films on very loud speakers.
Sounds like this man needs some headphones and maybe a new interest.
Hey, are you coming to game night at the library?
I don't know.
It says they have prizes up for grabs.
Prizes? What prizes? I love prizes.
It just says here, “Five prizes up for grabs, so come ready to play!”
Maybe you'll win one!
One? Maybe I'll win five!
Confidence helps, I guess.
Andrew, did you watch the baseball game last night?
Yes, I did.
And I saw us lose, again. We need some new players.
Well, they're getting better. And they tried really hard!
Yeah, they try hard, but the bottom line is, you have to hit the ball to win.
They weren't hitting.
Andrew, last night at a friend's house, I broke her expensive vase.
Now she wants me to buy her a new one.
Well, it was your fault.
No, it wasn't. It was right near where we were disco dancing!
Well, in that case, split the difference. You both pay half.
Yeah, I guess we both were to blame.
So, are you feeling excited now that the holidays are in full swing?
No! I’m really stressed! I’m always the one planning everything – the food, the shopping, the decorations!
It sounds like your holiday stress levels are in full swing, too. Try some deep breathing.
Good idea. Relax. Ooh!
Andrew, those stocks I told you to buy are a bit down. But don’t worry.
I know. And I’m taking my money out of those stocks.
Now is not the time to jump ship! Just be patient. The price will go up.
I am a patient person, except when it comes to my money.
Andrew, do you know Bob in accounting?
Is he the guy who’s always wearing shorts and sneakers?
That’s him. But today he’s wearing a suit!
Oh, a suit! Well, that’s a dead giveaway. He has an interview.
For another job, yep.
Let’s go to...what’s on your head?
A wig! You invited me to a funny hair party. So...
I said, “funding fair.” The money managers are here for a funding fair.
My bad. Well, I’m here. So, let’s go!
Not like that. You’re going to stick out like a sore thumb.
No one’s going to notice, Andrew.
So, my friend -- who hasn’t contacted me in two years -- just texted me, but she wrote almost nothing.
What did she write?
She only wrote “hello” and added a happy sun face. What does this mean??
It means “hello happy sun face.” Don’t read into it. It’s just a text.
No. You don’t know her. There’s got to be more to it than that.
Hey, Anna, are you all packed for Martha’s big camping trip?
Yeah, but my gear is really old. It’s not up to snuff for a big camping adventure.
I wouldn’t worry. Martha’s idea of camping is very comfortable. I’m pretty sure we are “camping” in modern cabins.
So, it’s not camping adventure at all! Is it?
Andrew, I saw the best action film this weekend -- “Super Shark”! You’ve got to see it.
Usually, I only watch classic films with complex story lines.
Well, this film has amazing special effects and AWESOME music.
But classic films stand the test of time. Super Shark will be quickly forgotten.
Not if they make “Super Shark 2.”
Andrew, my neighbor is doing something bad. Last night I saw her dragging something heavy across her yard.
She was probably taking out the trash, or gardening.
At night? No, it was definitely something illegal. I can feel it in my bones.
The last time you felt something in your bones, you were totally wrong.
Anna, someone in the office coffee club complained about you.
What?! What did they say?
They said you drink way too much coffee.
Ahhh! Who would say such a false, terrible thing about me?
I don’t want to point fingers, but it’s a man. In accounting. It’s Bob. Bob in accounting. He said it.
So, how has work training been going, Dan?
I feel like I’m drinking from a fire hose. Ten hours straight, every single day, is a lot.
Wow. Things sure are different from when I started. Back then, training was more like drinking from a little small straw.
Wow. Must have been nice. That sounds a lot easier.
Anna, I took your advice. I asked my soccer coach if he could cut our practice hours.
Practicing three days a week is way too much. Good for you!
No. Bad for me! He doubled down. Now we have to practice four days a week!
Sorry. At least you’ll be in shape.
Or injured!
My friend’s new car is amazing! It has all the latest bells and whistles.
Really? What features does it have?
Well, it has a karaoke machine, self-parking…
Wait! How many songs on the karaoke machine?
I don’t know, thousands?
Gasp!
What is wrong with that woman?
Katie? Nothing. Why do you ask?
Well, she’s outside hitting a tree.
She does that to let off steam.
Look, we all need to let out frustrations. But why take it out on a poor tree?
Jonathan, do you want to go see Nellie Fratelli's Big Band Blowout with me?
Nellie Fratelli? Didn’t she retire last year?
I don’t think so.
We saw her last show together. She even called it her “Swan Song Soiree.”
No, no, no, that was Nellie Fratelli's Frittata Cantata.
How’s your new publishing job going, Anna?
Don’t get me started. I’ve had NO training! I don’t know what to do or how to do it.
Sounds like you’ve been left to sink or swim.
Yes! And I’m sinking, Jonathan! I’m sinking!
Jonathan, do you have plans to go anywhere for the long weekend?
Nah, I’m going to make this holiday a staycation. My last vacation outside the city was A LOT of work.
I hope you enjoy your staycation … hey like the song! “Staycation all I ever wanted...
“...Staycation meant to be spent at home.”
So, I heard Reggie raised the most money for the Save the Plankton contest.
Yeah, and you should have seen him. When he accepted the award, he was proud as a peacock.
Well, he did raise a lot of money for an important cause.
But it’s not about him, Jonathan. It’s about the plankton!
Jonathan, what are you doing about the plankton problem?
Plankton problem? I don’t know about any plankton problem.
I feel like the whole world is burying its head in the sand about the plankton problem.
I’m not avoiding the plankton problem. I know nothing about the plankton problem!
Hey, how was the party at Bernie’s last weekend?
Well, it was a mixed bag.
What do you mean?
The people were interesting, but the food was awful. The music was great, but it was way too loud.
That does sound like a mixed bag.
Jonathan, remember last year when you laughed at me for making hats for my cat?
I didn’t just laugh. I also said I was worried about you.
Well, I was way ahead of the curve. Cat hats are selling online, right now, for a lot of money!
Of course they do.
Jonathan, Jackie got a promotion! But it’s in New York City.
Um, what do you mean by “but?” That sounds great!
She lives in a small town and likes being a big fish in a small pond.
That’s true. New York City is definitely not a small pond.
Hey Anna, are you still riding with me to Maggie’s party later?
Yes! And I took a nap earlier, so I am ready to par-tay!
Great! Dollars to donuts we get stuck in traffic on the way, though.
Dollars to donuts Maggie’s party will last way past midnight.
Hey, how is that children’s book project going?
I’ve been working on it for so long that I can’t see the forest for the trees!
You should take a break. Come back in a few days. Then you’ll be able to see the whole story much better.
Good idea.
Jonathan, how was the Maná concert last night?
Amazing! They played all my favorite songs. But the icing on the cake was getting to meet the band after the show!
Wow, that is icing on the cake.
The lead singer even gave me the headband he wore on stage!
Jonathan, Caty just told me my script was good…surprisingly good.
That, my friend, is a backhanded compliment.
Yes! She was surprised it was good. So, she was expecting it to be bad.
Oh, let it go, Anna. Backhanded or not, it’s still a compliment.
I am so tired. I don’t think I’ve slept for two days.
Why haven’t you been sleeping?
I’ve been swamped with work. It just seems like I’m never able to get everything done.
Jonathan, you need your sleep! Your health is more important than work.
You’re right. But what I really need is a vacation.
Anna, where did you go with that red wagon?
Jonathan, I needed exercise and fruit.
Ah. So, you killed two birds with one stone by pulling the wagon to the store.
Yes! Now, if I can just find a way to read at the same time.
Ooh, be careful.
Jonathan, how did your virtual family reunion go?
Well...I’ve told you about my Uncle Bill, right?
You’ve said he’s a bit of a loose cannon. Uh oh. What happened?
First, he insulted my mom’s cooking. Then he started yelling about politics.
Jonathan! I have a riddle. You’ll never guess the answer.
Anna, I’m a little busy right now.
Just take a stab at it. What gets wetter and wetter the more it dries?
I don’t know. A towel?
Yeah. You're right.
I am so tired.
Another bad night?
Yep! I was falling asleep, and then, right on cue, the guy upstairs turned up his music, and all I could hear was boom, boom, boom, for the next three hours!
Why didn’t you ask him to turn it down?
I was too tired to get out of bed!
Andrew, I have found the perfect pizza. Perfect Pizza Palace!
That place is way too expensive.
Maybe. But their pizza is head and shoulders above all the other pizza places in this city! And I’ve tried them all.
You could not…
All.
Andrew, did you throw a surprise party for Tammy?
Yes! It was great and she was tickled pink!
Well, I just got a text from her and she seems angry. “I hate birthday parties.” “I hate surprises.” Uh, “I don’t eat cake.”
Oh, no. Sounds like she was not “tickled pink.”
No. Most definitely not. Oh.
This new video editing program is so complicated. I just want to use the old one.
No way! Look at all the choices we have! In the long run, our videos are going to look awesome!
I just want them to look awesome, now!
Look! I made you a cat. Ha, ha, ha, ha, ha…
My best friend hired this really young guy to plan her wedding, and he’s just awful.
Well, if he’s young, you can probably chalk it up to his inexperience.
Well, 20% of his errors are from inexperience. The other 80% is from lack of preparation and basic knowledge.
Wow, you did math. You must’ve given this some thought.
Today I’m playing for the first time with a classical music group! They’ve been together for years, so I’m nervous.
Being the new person is fun! Bring new ideas. Make some waves!
I don’t really make waves; I’ll just follow along.
I know... suggest a rock song!
Um…no.
Dan, our presentation for the group is at 3. It’s 2:15 and we have so much to do! We’ll never be ready!
Yes, we will. We just need to divide and conquer. Okay, you print the handouts. I’ll prepare the laptop and load the slideshow.
We also need to book a meeting room!!
Ashley can do it.
Whoa, Dan! Nice beard!
I shaved this morning! But I’ve been drinking this new spinach juice and now my facial hair grows like crazy.
That is your five o’clock shadow? Wow.
I think I just need to stop shaving and just grow a beard.
Um, you already have one, my friend.
Okay, Dan. Let’s get this right for our presentation tomorrow. Our 3rd quarter earnings went up five percent!
No. Our 3rd quarter earnings were down five percent. Our 4th quarter earnings went up.
No, Dan. Our 4th quarter was bad. Get your act together.
Me? Your numbers are all wrong. Get your act together!
You know, Anna, good friends are hard to find.
Are they? I hadn’t noticed.
My “friend” is always talking about how he loves to help others. But when I asked for his help, he said he was busy!
Sounds like your friend was just paying you lip service. What did you need help with?
Just moving my heavy couch up five flights of stairs. Oh hey, umm, are you…?
No, no, I’m really busy.
It’s 3:02. Where is everybody?
Dan, relax, people are going to come.
I specifically said on the invitation 3 o’clock. So rude.
It’s not rude, Dan. It’s par for the course for people to come a little later to a party.
It’s not par for the course for me.
Hey, I’m heading to the lunch meeting. You want to walk with me?
Um, no thanks. I’m busy doing other things, far away with other people.
What are you doing? Where are you going? Who are you meeting?
Dan, stop with the third degree!
If you don’t want so many questions, I need answers!
So, are you doing anything fun over the long weekend?
Yes! I’m going on a midnight hike at Fort Danger Park!
Is that a good idea? Weird things happen at Fort Danger Park even in the daytime.
It’s not as sketchy as people think. I hike there at night all the time!
Of course you do.
Dan, can you help bring in the cake for the work party? It’s big.
Um, I’m not the best person to ask. I’m all thumbs.
Oh, then forget it. I don’t want anything to happen to this cake!
Is there anything else I can help with?
Sure. You can throw the bags of ice on the ground to break up the ice.
Yes! Like I said, I’m great at dropping things.
Okay, Dan. I get it now. I understand your obsession. Pickleball is so much fun!
I’m glad you’ve finally seen the light. It is the best sport!
It is! It’s so easy. You barely have to run, or even move!
Okay, well, serious players might disagree with that statement.
I need to print a report for a meeting in five minutes! And the printer is not printing!
I can help. First, open drawer #2 and move the papers around. Then check areas 4-B and 5-C and maybe…
You’re not helping. You’re making my head swim!
Or I could just print it for you.
Whoa, Dan! What happened to your face?
I got hit with the ball during last night’s softball game. Turns out the balls are not all that soft.
Well, that’s quite a shiner. Hey, maybe next time catch the ball with your glove and not your face.
Thanks, Anna. Thanks a lot.
